// LatestExemplarTimestamp returns the timestamp of the newest exemplar stored for the series
// with the given labels. The second return value is false if the series has no exemplars.
func (ce *CircularExemplarStorage) LatestExemplarTimestamp(l labels.Labels) (int64, bool) {
	var buf [1024]byte
	seriesLabels := l.Bytes(buf[:])
	ce.lock.RLock()
	defer ce.lock.RUnlock()
	idx, ok := ce.index[string(seriesLabels)]
	if !ok {
		return 0, false
	}
	return ce.exemplars[idx.newest].exemplar.Ts, true
}
```

func (ce *CircularExemplarStorage) HasExemplarAtOrAfter(l labels.Labels, mint int64) bool {
	var buf [1024]byte

	}

func (ce *CircularExemplarStorage) HasExemplarAtOrAfter(seriesLabels labels.Labels, mint int64) bool {

// series with the given labels whose timestamp is at or after ts. Zero and negative
// timestamps are treated like any other timestamp.
func (ce *CircularExemplarStorage) HasExemplarAtOrAfter(l labels.Labels, ts int64) bool {
	var buf [1024]byte
	seriesLabels := l.Bytes(buf[:])

	defer ce.lock.RUnlock()
	idx, ok := ce.index[string(seriesLabels)]

	return ce.exemplars[idx.newest].exemplar.Ts >= ts
}

// releaseInOrderChunks drops all in-order chunks from the series and clears
// the appender, advancing firstChunkID so that chunks created by later appends
// get fresh IDs. It returns the number of chunks released. The caller must hold
// the series lock.
func (s *memSeries) releaseInOrderChunks() int {
	removed := len(s.mmappedChunks) + int(s.headChunkCount.Load())
	if removed == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	s.firstChunkID = wrapChunkID(s.firstChunkID + chunks.HeadChunkID(removed))
	s.setHeadChunks(nil, 0)
	s.mmappedChunks = nil
	s.app = nil
	return removed
}
```

func (ce *CircularExemplarStorage) hasExemplarAtOrAfter(l labels.Labels, mint int64) bool {
	var buf [1024]byte
	seriesLabels := l.Bytes(buf[:])

	ce.lock.RLock()
	defer ce.lock.RUnlock()

	idx, ok := ce.index[string(seriesLabels)]
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	return ce.exemplars[idx.newest].exemplar.Ts >= mint
}
